description: Send a transactional or marketing email to one or more recipients.

to.description: List of recipients; minimum 1 entry. Each entry has email (required) and name (optional).

reply_to.description: Optional reply-to email address; must be a valid email

template_id.description: Optional template ID; if provided, body is ignored

body.description: Email body content; required when template_id is not provided

cc.description: Optional list of CC email addresses

priority.description: Send priority: low, normal, or high

headers.description: Optional custom email headers as arbitrary string key-value pairs

tracking.description: Optional tracking configuration for this email send

click_tracking.description: Whether to track link clicks within the email

utm_campaign.description: Optional UTM campaign identifier appended to tracked links

send_at.description: Optional ISO8601 datetime to schedule the email for future delivery; if omitted, sends immediately

tags.description: Optional list of tags for categorising and filtering sent emails

filename.description: Name of the file as it will appear to the recipient

content_type.description: MIME type of the attachment (e.g. application/pdf)

url.description: Publicly accessible URL from which the attachment content will be fetched

sample_payload.subject: Your weekly summary
sample_payload.body: Here is your activity for this week.
